title: feat: implement Console roadmap P0–P1 ListView spec properties and NavigationOverlay renderView
body:
Implements outstanding P0/P1 items from the Console roadmap: ListView spec-compliant properties and NavigationOverlay view-specific rendering.

### ListViewSchema type extensions (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`)

- `rowHeight: 'compact' | 'medium' | 'tall'` — maps to density mode when `densityMode` not set
- `conditionalFormatting[]` — field/operator/value rules with background/text/border colors
- `inlineEdit: boolean` — passed as `editable` to grid child view
- `aria: { label, describedBy, live }` — applied to root container with `role="region"`
- `sharing: { visibility, enabled }` — renders Share button in toolbar

### ListView implementation (`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`)

- `rowHeight` → density mapping: `compact`→`compact`, `medium`→`comfortable`, `tall`→`spacious`
- Exported `evaluateConditionalFormatting()` for rule evaluation by child views
- `conditionalFormatting` and `inlineEdit` forwarded to grid schema
- ARIA attributes spread onto root `<div role="region">`

### NavigationOverlay `renderView` support (`packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`)

Added optional `renderView` prop. When both `renderView` and `view` are provided, overlay content renders via `renderView(record, viewName)` instead of default `children`. Backwards compatible — falls back to `children` when either is absent.

```tsx
<NavigationOverlay
  {...nav}
  view="contact-detail"
  renderView={(record, viewName) => <DetailForm record={record} view={viewName} />}
>
  {(record) => <DefaultView record={record} />}
</NavigationOverlay>
```

### ROADMAP.md

Marked verified P0.1–P0.4 and P1.1–P1.2 items as complete based on codebase audit and new implementations.
